_comment: Example project-level .claude/settings.json wiring Claude Code to Domo's Snowflake Cortex Anthropic endpoint. Copy the non-_comment keys into your project's .claude/settings.json. The apiKeyHelper path points at the cortex-key-helper.sh you place under bin/ (see scripts/cortex-key-helper.sh in this plugin); it pulls a Snowflake PAT from the macOS Keychain (service name 'domo-ai-devkit-snowflake-pat') so no token is stored on disk.
